Account created successfully! Welcome to Actifit.
Unable to prepare the signup request. Please try again.

Secure signup recovery could not be removed. Please try again.
An earlier signup saved on this device can\'t be read, so it can\'t be resumed. If you already paid for it, contact Actifit support before discarding it. Discard it to start a new signup.
Your signup may still complete. Your credentials will remain encrypted on this device so you can safely resume later.
A secure interrupted signup is available on this device.
This signup may already have a payment or account creation in progress. Its encrypted credentials must remain recoverable. Resume the signup to check its status.

This signup may already have a payment or account creation in progress. Discarding permanently deletes its encrypted credentials on this device — if an account was created, you may lose access to it. Discard anyway?
Posting Key — THIS is the key you use to log in to Actifit. Save it alongside your Master Password.
The confirmation request reached its 60-second limit. Your signup status is still unknown, so Actifit is checking Hive without submitting another request.
Your signup status is not known yet. Actifit will check Hive without submitting another confirmation request.
Your account is not visible on Hive yet. No new confirmation request was sent. You can check again safely.

Please enter a valid email address.

Your promo code covers the account. No payment is needed: tap Claim Promo to create it.
The signup price could not be loaded. Please try again.
New signups are paused right now. Please try again later.
New signups are paused right now. Please try again later. If you already paid, your account will still be created: check again later.
Too many attempts from your network. Please wait a while and try again.
That referrer account does not exist. Check the name or leave it empty.
Your payment has not arrived yet. Payments usually show up within a minute. If you sent it, tap Check status again shortly.
The signup server is busy. Your details are saved: tap Check status again in a minute.
The payment received is less than %1$s %2$s. Payments are not added together: send the full amount with the same memo to create your account. Actifit support will refund the smaller payment.

If you already sent %1$s %2$s with memo %3$s, do not change anything: tap Check Payment instead. Changing these details gives a new memo, and a payment with the old memo can only be refunded by Actifit support.

This username was taken by someone else before your account could be created. If you sent a payment, do not send another one: Actifit support will refund it. You can start over with a different username.
This removes the saved signup and its master password from this device. Any payment you sent for it is still refunded by Actifit support.

This signup was started with an older version of Actifit (memo %1$s) and can no longer be completed. If you sent a payment with that memo, do not send it again: contact Actifit support for a refund. You can start a new signup.
If you already sent %1$s %2$s with memo %3$s, choose Leave for now: your signup stays saved on this device so you can finish it. Discard only if you have not paid.

This signup was started with an older version of Actifit (memo %1$s). Its account could not be checked right now: tap Check status to try again. If the account was never created and you sent a payment with that memo, contact Actifit support for a refund.
